raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Current DeepSeek V4, V41's chat template doesn't render response format content, which is not aligned with DeepSeek's API doc: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion/ This PR injects the request's `response_format` into the system prompt so it can be rendered correctly. Notes: - **Unsupported Formats:** While SGLang supports additional response formats (such as structural tags), these are not supported according to the API documentation and are intentionally excluded from rendering. - **DeepSeek Compatibility:** `json_schema` is converted to `json_object` by default to align with DeepSeek's official API specifications. ## Modifications - Added `response_format` rendering into the system prompt construction. - Filtered out unsupported format types (e.g., structural tags, text) to comply with official API specs. ## Example (Before vs After) ```shell # server export MODEL_PATH=/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark/62af8fffb2f7030cac4de2f0169f5b8d1101b646/ sglang serve --model-path $MODEL_PATH --tp 4 --moe-runner-backend marlin --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 --max-running-requests 32 --trust-remote-code --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30010 --reasoning-parser deepseek-v4 --tool-call-parser deepseekv4 ``` client: [response_format.sh](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33658907/response_format.sh) [detoken.py](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33659026/detoken.py) ```shell export MODEL_PATH=/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark/62af8fffb2f7030cac4de2f0169f5b8d1101b646/ bash response_format.sh && python detoken.py ``` **Before**: ```text <｜begin▁of▁sentence｜><｜User｜>Who are you<｜Assistant｜> ``` **After**: ```text <｜begin▁of▁sentence｜> ## Response Format: You MUST strictly adhere to the following schema to reply: {"type": "json_object", "json_schema": {"name": "require_named", "description": "a schema for the response format", "schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "description": "the name", "enum": ["Muqi Li", "Muqi1029"]}, "age": {"type": "integer", "description": "a number from 0 to 25, which represent the person's age", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 25}}, "required": ["name", "age"], "additionalProperties": false}, "strict": true}}<｜User｜>Who are you<｜Assistant｜> ``` ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #39897435033](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39897435033) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #39897435012](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39897435012) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #39897435046](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39897435046)

Since it is still unclear how DeepSeek's open-source chat template officially handles `response_format`, I will leave this PR here for now.

In the meantime, rendering the raw schema from `json_schema` into the system prompt is much more practical—it guides constrained decoding properly and helps avoid the infinite whitespace generation issue highlighted in the official API docs.

I will follow up with more feedback after testing this rendering logic further.

> Since it is still unclear how DeepSeek's open-source chat template officially handles `response_format`, I will leave this PR here for now.
> 
> In the meantime, rendering the raw schema from `json_schema` into the system prompt is much more practical—it guides constrained decoding properly and helps avoid the infinite whitespace generation issue highlighted in the official API docs.
> 
> I will follow up with more feedback after testing this rendering logic further.

Now DeepSeek open source its Inference Engine, I will learn it and follow up

Closing as superseded by #45315 (merged), which routes DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 chat prompting through deepseek-recipe and already covers official `response_format` rendering plus the DeepSeek `tool_choice` path (`none` omits tools; named choice is filtered in `_process_messages` before the recipe adapter).

Thanks for the reviews and discussion.

Question: why relabel json_schema to json_object instead of rendering the dump as-is? The result is `{"type": "json_object", "json_schema": {...}}`, which contradicts itself. There's no official ground truth here (DeepSeek's API rejects json_schema outright), and the grammar backend already constrains output to the schema, so the prompt is advisory either way — but keeping the original type seems more honest.
